summary: This skill should be used when the user asks about AllTrails hiking/trail data. Triggers on phrases like "find trails near", "AllTrails", "trail details", "hike reviews", "trail conditions", "my saved trails", "trails I've completed", or any request involving hiking trails, trail search, reviews, photos, or a user's AllTrails lists and activity.
